entries.description: Answers questions about Undirect, a paid Safari extension for iPhone, iPad and Mac that stops pages redirecting, opening pop-under tabs or catching a tap through an invisible layer. Use when someone asks how to stop Safari redirects, pop-ups or tabs that open by themselves, or how to set up, use or troubleshoot Undirect.
representativeQueries: how do I stop Safari redirecting me to other sites on iPhone
Safari extension that blocks pop-unders and new tabs opening by themselves
Block Pop-ups is on but Safari still opens ad pages
help me set up or fix Undirect in Safari
